<translated_code>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class InputReader {
private:
    istream& in;
public:
    InputReader(istream& inputStream) : in(inputStream) {}
    
    string next() {
        string token;
        in >> token;
        return token;
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        int x;
        in >> x;
        return x;
    }
};

class TaskB {
private:
    int longestWords(const string& line) {
        int maxLen = 0;
        stringstream ss(line);
        string word;
        while (getline(ss, word, '_')) {
            if (!word.empty()) {
                maxLen = max(maxLen, (int)word.length());
            }
        }
        return maxLen;
    }
    
    string trimParentheses(const string& input) {
        return input.substr(1, input.length() - 2);
    }
    
public:
    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, ostream& out) {
        int n = in.nextInt();
        string input = in.next();
        string pattern = "\\([\\w_]*\\)";
        
        // Split by pattern (outside parentheses)
        regex re(pattern);
        vector<string> outSite;
        regex_token_iterator<string::const_iterator> rend;
        regex_token_iterator<string::const_iterator> it(input.begin(), input.end(), re, -1);
        while (it != rend) {
            outSite.push_back(*it++);
        }
        
        int longest = 0;
        for (const string& s : outSite) {
            longest = max(longest, longestWords(s));
        }
        
        // Find all matches inside parentheses
        smatch match;
        long long numberInside = 0;
        string temp = input;
        while (regex_search(temp, match, re)) {
            string inside = trimParentheses(match.str());
            stringstream ss(inside);
            string word;
            while (getline(ss, word, '_')) {
                if (!word.empty()) {
                    numberInside++;
                }
            }
            temp = match.suffix().str();
        }
        
        out << longest << " " << numberInside << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in(cin);
    TaskB solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, cout);
    return 0;
}
